text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D and E at gains felt satisfying, but I should judge each holding by its future prospects, not just whether it is above my cost.","Avoiding sales to avoid admitting a loss can keep me tied to a poor investment; my purchase price is not a reason to hold.","With prices moving randomly and no trades made in most periods, I should avoid reacting to short-term changes and make deliberate, diversified decisions."]}
